text.p: Cyprus stocks inched higher on Wednesday, recovering slightly from declines caused at the beginning of the month by investors shunning the market.
The 41-share general index of the CSE closed at 81.08 on Wednesday, up 14 basis points from trading on Tuesday but still 40 basis points below its level last Friday.
ThE banking stock index closed at 90.25 on Wednesday, slipping 0.21 percent from its close of 90.44 on Friday.
Bank of Cyprus fully paid shares slid two cents to close at 337.5 on Wednesday from 339.5 on Friday. Fully paid shares of the Cyprus Popular Bank gained 2.5 cents, closing at 329.5.
Hellenic Bank fully paid shares lost three cents to close at 253.5. Shares in the Universal Savings Bank went down 1.5 cents, closing at 133.
The sub-index of insurance companies closed at 55.55 on Wednesday from 56.13 on Friday.
National carrier Cyprus Airways remained unchanged at 0.372, its year low reached last Friday as no trading with company shares occurred.
"For lack of a better explanation I would say it is lack of investor interest," said one trader.
Shares in Universal Life Insurance closed at 368.5, down six cents from its close on Friday. Paneuropean Insurance at 114, 2.5 cents lower than its close on Friday.
Interamerican Insurance closed at 100.5, unchanged from Friday.
In the manufacturing sector, Vassiliko cement closed on Wednesday at 162, down half a cent. The Cyprus Cement Company closed at 255 on Wednesday, down five cents from Friday.
